item.title: Pastor seeks help as bandits ‘demand N1bn ransom’ for eight abducted Kwara worshippers
item.description: Suspected bandits have reportedly demanded a ransom of N1 billion to free eight abducted members of the Evangelical Church of West Africa (ECWA), Omugo, in Ifelodun LGA of Kwara state. Gunmen had attacked the church on Sunday, shooting sporadically during service to scare the congregation and abducted some members. item.title: Matawalle rules out 2027 Zamfara guber bid, backs Dauda Lawal’s re-election
item.description: Bello Matawalle, former governor of Zamfara, says he will not contest the 2027 governorship election in the state. Matawalle, the minister of state for defence, noted that he will support the re-election of Dauda Lawal. He made the declaration on Tuesday in Gusau, the state capital, during the official reception of Governor Lawal into the All Progressives Congress (APC). item.title: Ex-Google Executive Matt Brittin Appointed New BBC Director-Genera
item.description: The BBC has named former Google executive Matt Brittin as its new Director-General, marking a significant shift for the public broadcaster as it navigates challenges from digital competition and funding pressures.Brittin, who served as President of Google for Europe, the Middle East and Africa for nearly two decades before stepping down in 2024, is set to become the corporation’s 18th Director-General.
